name: Laplace Beltrami Spectrum: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
summary: Computes the Laplace-Beltrami spectrum (eigenvalues and eigenvectors) of each VTK surface mesh in a 3D surfaces dataset with compiled MATLAB code.
description: For every .vtk mesh in the input surfaces directory, normalizes the mesh by surface area, builds the cotangent Laplacian and barycentric mass matrix, and solves for the spectrum_size smallest eigenpairs. Eigenvalues go to spectrum.json and, when save_eigenvectors is true, eigenvectors go to eigenvectors.mat. Use it for shape analysis or to reconstruct surfaces from eigenfunctions; meshes with too few vertices for the requested spectrum are skipped.

inputs.description: Directory of triangle surface meshes in VTK format, one per structure.
inputs.requirements: Only *.vtk files are read; each mesh needs more vertices than spectrum_size.

outputs.description: spectrum.json with the Laplace-Beltrami eigenvalues for each surface, keyed by surface name.
eigenvectors.mat (MATLAB v7.3) with the eigenvectors for each surface, written when save_eigenvectors is true.

citations.text: Kitchell L. Shape Analysis of Human White Matter Tracts: An Examination of Normal Morphological Variability and the Association Between Morphology, Brain Size, and Behavior. Indiana University (2020).
